instrument.name: grok-imagine
instrument.notes: image_gen and image_edit do not accept a seed. Hold subject by generating a locked anchor, then image_edit that file while asking for a single change.

jobs.prompt: Preserve the same subject, identity, pose, framing, crop, camera position, and key-light direction. Do not change wardrobe, props, or scene content. Do not restyle the picture into a period look, a movie still, or a genre.  Change only halation. Set halation to: clean highlights with no bleed into adjacent darks. Do not globally soften the image, do not add grain, do not crush the whole tone scale, and do not change the subject's materials.
hold_constant: Do not globally soften the image, do not add grain, do not crush the whole tone scale, and do not change the subject's materials.
